name: Bubbling Pile of Orts
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-01: Intro to the Year of Battle's Spark: Enough is Enough
description: A rift to Hell crackles with unstable energy from the broken summoning circle as a squirming mass of fiends struggles to emerge A blood mist projection of a Hellknight angrily commands them.
disable: DC 19 Arcana , DC 19 Nature , DC 19 Occultism , or DC 19 Religion (2 actions) (trained) while within 15 feet to weaken the rift, dealing 3d4 Spirit Damage damage to it. This damage has the holy trait.
routine: (1 action) The Hellknight commands the orts, and the trap lashes out at each enemy creature in its space and adjacent, dealing (1d10+6) Slashing Damage damage (Basic DC 18 Reflex Saving Throw save) If no enemy is in reach, an ort emerges in an adjacent square.

offensiveAbilities.name: Hellfire
offensiveAbilities.description: All orts within 30 feet have +1 status bonus to hit and deal 1d4 extra fire damage on a hit.

offensiveAbilities.name: Bubble
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The trap receives a critical hit or critically fails a saving throw

Effect One ort emerges adjacent.

offensiveAbilities.name: Planar Breach
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The magic circle is broken

Effect The pile disgorges orts and then rolls initiative.
